title: Screamer Speedboat & Dolphin Watch
specs: High success rate of dolphin sightings
44-foot, high-powered, custom designed vessel with seating for up to 38 passengers
Not appropriate for those with neck, back and heart injuries/concerns or for those who are pregnant
includes: US Coast Guard licensed captains and crew
blurb: Guests enjoy a 60 minute boat ride on a 44-foot, high-powered speedboat with seating for up to 38 passengers. The ride offers panoramic views of the coastline and marine life, including frequent dolphin sightings. The crew actively searches for dolphins and other marine wildlife during the trip.
extraNote: Reservations are required and strongly suggested in advance; walk ups welcome but seating not guaranteed · Trip schedule and route subject to change due to weather and sea conditions
